Caja delimitadorac Volver a índice o Índice de clases

IRI: https://w3id.org/earthsemantics/OSO#BoundingBox

Representa un área geográfica rectangular definida por límites de coordenadas norte, sur, este y oeste. Este concepto está alineado con ISO 19115-3 e interoperable con las geometrías GeoSPARQL.
Una caja geográfica delimitadora que define la extensión espacial de un sitio de observación marina, infraestructura regional, plataforma o recurso relacionado.

Infraestructura de Investigaciónc Volver a índice o Índice de clases

IRI: https://w3id.org/earthsemantics/OSO#ResearchInfrastructure

Una infraestructura de investigación puede reunir una o más Instalaciones Regionales.
The following definition for RI from Article 2 (6) of the Regulation (EU) No 1291/2013 of 11 December 2013: `Establishing Horizon 2020 - the Framework Programme for Research and Innovation (2014-2020)` applies: “RI are facilities, resources and services that are used by the research communities to conduct research and foster innovation in their fields. They include: major scientific equipment (or sets of instruments), knowledge-based resources such as collections, archives and scientific data, e-infrastructures, such as data and computing systems and communication networks and any other tools that are essential to achieve excellence in research and innovation.” Accordingly, RI are implemented along different organisational models, including central sources and laboratories for experiments and measurement sessions, coordination and management of geographically distributed observatories or laboratories, remotely accessible resources for computing, data banks, physical sample repositories, surveys and longitudinal studies.

Organisation c, Organization c

description ap "The ATLANTIC WHALE DEAL aims to make sure that ships don't accidentally hit whales in the Atlantic Area. Partners from different countries are working together to prevent these collisions that can damage biodiversity, trying out new and smart technologies to reduce ship strikes. They want to help the environment by capturing carbon (which is good for the planet) and making sure the ecosystem works well. This involves localization techniques to find whales, making maps to show where there's a risk of collisions, and creating tools to reduce noise in the ocean. A team of experts in physics, engineering, biology, statistics, design, and social economics from four countries is teaming up with different organizations like the government, non-profit groups, schools, and businesses. The goal is to find solutions that work well and help society while also taking care of the planet. ATLANTIC WHALE DEAL believes that by protecting whales, they're also making a positive impact on the world by keeping the environment healthy and preserving biodiversity."@en

description ap "The E1M3A marine observatory is a pioneer station, the first open-ocean buoy in the Mediterranean deployed in January 2000 and currently part of the POSEIDON network since 2007. The Poseidon system operates a network of fixed measuring floats, which are moored at various locations in the Aegean and Ionian seas delivering near-real-time observations on important marine and atmospheric parameters. The oceanographic buoys constitute the backbone of the POSEIDON system and they are linked to both global and regional networks such as the OceanSITES and M3A’s respectively. In particular the POSEIDON E1 M3A buoy (WMO 61277) is the founder component of the Cretan Sea observatory complemented with several other platforms such as glider, FerryBox and a coastal buoy and is currently the most heavily equipped physical–biogeochemical observing site of the POSEIDON system."@en

description ap "EMSO-France Research Infrastructure, included in the MESR roadmap, coordinates French initiatives on underwater observatories within the European programme and promotes their openness to a wide range of teams and disciplines. France’s involvement is driven by its expertise in data management, technological innovation, and the strategic selection of observatory deployment sites: the Azores site on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, within Portugal’s EEZ, the Ligurian Sea site, east on the Nice slope and west in the deep continental margin area, linked to the IN2P3 neutrino telescope, the Marmara Sea site along the North Anatolian Fault, the Iroise Sea test site, initially located offshore Molène, currently being relocated to Brest harbour."@en
description ap "L’infrastructure de recherche EMSO-France, inscrite dans la feuille de route du MESR, coordonne les initiatives françaises sur les observatoires sous-marins du programme européen et favorise leur ouverture à un large éventail d’équipes et de disciplines. L’engagement de la France repose sur son expertise en gestion de données, en innovation technologique et sur le choix stratégique des sites d’implantation des observatoires : le site des Açores sur la dorsale médio-atlantique, dans la ZEE du Portugal, le site de la mer Ligure, à l’est sur la pente de Nice et à l’ouest dans la zone profonde du talus continental, en lien avec le télescope à neutrinos de l’IN2P3, le site de la mer de Marmara sur la faille nord-anatolienne, le site d’essai en mer d’Iroise, initialement au large de Molène, en cours de relocalisation en rade de Brest."@fr

description ap "A região do Golfo de Cádis é extremamente importante para os riscos geológicos. Foi o local do devastador terramoto e tsunami de 1755 que afetou a Europa. A convergência das placas tectónicas africana e euroasiática torna esta região altamente ativa do ponto de vista sísmico e vulcânico. A Margem Ibérica é também uma região oceanográfica fundamental onde ocorre a troca de águas atlânticas e mediterrânicas, influenciando a circulação meridional do Atlântico (AMOC). Representa a parte mais setentrional do Sistema de Afloramento das Canárias (CCUS), caracterizado por forte afloramento costeiro e intensa dinâmica de mesoescala. Estas condições geológicas e oceanográficas favorecem ecossistemas bentónicos altamente diversos e desempenham um papel importante na distribuição de mamíferos marinhos e espécies de peixes."@pt
description ap "La région du golfe de Cadix est particulièrement importante pour les aléas géologiques. Elle a été le siège du séisme et du tsunami dévastateurs de 1755 ayant affecté l’Europe. La convergence des plaques tectoniques africaine et eurasienne rend cette région fortement active sur les plans sismique et volcanique. La marge ibérique constitue également une zone océanographique clé où les eaux atlantiques et méditerranéennes s’échangent, influençant la circulation méridienne de retournement atlantique (AMOC). Elle représente la partie la plus septentrionale du système d’upwelling des Canaries (CCUS), caractérisé par des remontées d’eaux profondes et une forte dynamique méso-échelle. Ces conditions géologiques et océanographiques favorisent une grande diversité des communautés benthiques ainsi qu’un rôle majeur dans la répartition de nombreuses espèces de mammifères marins et de poissons."@fr
description ap "The Gulf of Cadiz area is highly important for geo-hazards. It was the location of the devastating 1755 earthquake and tsunami that affected Europe. The convergence of the African and Eurasian tectonic plates makes this region seismically and volcanically active. The Iberian Margin is also a key oceanographic region where Atlantic and Mediterranean waters exchange, influencing the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). It is the northernmost part of the Canary Current Upwelling System (CCUS), characterised by strong upwelling and mesoscale ocean dynamics. These geological and oceanographic conditions support highly diverse benthic ecosystems and play an important role in the distribution of marine mammals and fish species."@en

description ap "Det integrerte LIFE-prosjektet Marha (Marine Habitats) har som mål å gjenopprette og opprettholde en god bevaringstilstand for naturlige marine habitater i fastlands-Frankrike. Fra 2018 til 2025 ble mer enn 650 tiltak innen vurdering, utprøving, forvaltning, bevisstgjøring og opplæring gjennomført, med deltakelse fra alle aktører involvert i forvaltningen av marine Natura 2000-områder."@no
description ap "El proyecto integrado LIFE Marha (Marine Habitats) tiene como objetivo restaurar y mantener el buen estado de conservación de los hábitats marinos naturales en la Francia metropolitana. Entre 2018 y 2025, se llevaron a cabo más de 650 acciones de evaluación, experimentación, gestión, sensibilización y formación, movilizando a todos los actores implicados en la gestión de los sitios Natura 2000 en el mar."@es
description ap "Il progetto LIFE integrato Marha (Marine Habitats) mira a ripristinare e mantenere il buono stato di conservazione degli habitat marini naturali nella Francia metropolitana. Dal 2018 al 2025 sono state realizzate oltre 650 azioni di valutazione, sperimentazione, gestione, sensibilizzazione e formazione, mobilitando tutti gli attori coinvolti nella gestione dei siti Natura 2000 marini."@it
description ap "Le projet LIFE intégré Marha (Marine Habitats) vise à rétablir et à maintenir le bon état de conservation des habitats naturels marins en France hexagonale. De 2018 à 2025, plus de 650 actions d’évaluation, d’expérimentation, de gestion, de sensibilisation et de formation ont été mises en œuvre, en mobilisant l’ensemble des acteurs impliqués dans la gestion des sites Natura 2000 en mer."@fr
description ap "O projeto integrado LIFE Marha (Marine Habitats) tem como objetivo restaurar e manter o bom estado de conservação dos habitats marinhos naturais na França continental. Entre 2018 e 2025, foram implementadas mais de 650 ações de avaliação, experimentação, gestão, sensibilização e formação, mobilizando todos os atores envolvidos na gestão dos sítios Natura 2000 marinhos."@pt
description ap "Proiectul integrat LIFE Marha (Marine Habitats) are ca obiectiv restabilirea și menținerea unei stări favorabile de conservare a habitatelor marine naturale din Franța continentală. Între 2018 și 2025 au fost implementate peste 650 de acțiuni de evaluare, experimentare, gestionare, sensibilizare și formare, mobilizând toți actorii implicați în gestionarea siturilor marine Natura 2000."@ro
description ap "The LIFE Integrated Project Marha (Marine Habitats) aims to restore and maintain the favourable conservation status of natural marine habitats in mainland France. From 2018 to 2025, more than 650 actions involving assessment, experimentation, management, awareness-raising and training were implemented, mobilising all stakeholders involved in the management of Natura 2000 marine sites."@en
description ap "Το ολοκληρωμένο πρόγραμμα LIFE Marha (Marine Habitats) στοχεύει στην αποκατάσταση και διατήρηση της καλής κατάστασης διατήρησης των φυσικών θαλάσσιων οικοτόπων στη μητροπολιτική Γαλλία. Από το 2018 έως το 2025, υλοποιήθηκαν περισσότερες από 650 δράσεις αξιολόγησης, πειραματισμού, διαχείρισης, ευαισθητοποίησης και κατάρτισης, κινητοποιώντας το σύνολο των φορέων που εμπλέκονται στη διαχείριση των θαλάσσιων περιοχών Natura 2000."@el

Mar Negroni Volver a índice o Índice de individuos

IRI: https://w3id.org/earthsemantics/OSO#Black_Sea

El Mar Negro es uno de los mares regionales más grandes del continente euroasiático y es único por muchas de sus características geográficas, geológicas, biológicas, hidrográficas y sociopolíticas. Las condiciones anóxicas en profundidad, los problemas relacionados con especies invasoras y las elevadas cargas de sedimentos transportadas al sistema hacen que esta zona presente desafíos particulares que requieren estaciones de observación a largo plazo. El Mar Negro se encuentra en una región geológicamente compleja donde interactúan tres grandes placas tectónicas (Euroasiática, Anatolia y Arábiga). Existen riesgos geológicos como terremotos, deslizamientos submarinos y desplazamientos a lo largo de fallas activas, que pueden desencadenar tsunamis junto con fenómenos meteorológicos extremos.

description ap "MARMOR (Marine Advanced Geophysical Research Equipment and Mayotte Multidisciplinary Observatory for Research and Response) est un projet d’une durée de huit ans financé par l’ANR. Le projet MARMOR a un double objectif : structurer la communauté scientifique française en fournissant à l’infrastructure de recherche Epos-France (anciennement Résif) les équipements nécessaires pour conduire des recherches d’excellence utilisant les outils de la sismologie et de la géodésie sous-marines, mettre en place une infrastructure d’observation sous-marine à Mayotte afin d’assurer une surveillance sismologique continue, en temps réel et 24/7, et de conduire des recherches multidisciplinaires sur les phénomènes associés à la crise sismo-volcanique en cours."@fr
description ap "MARMOR (Marine Advanced Geophysical Research Equipment and Mayotte Multidisciplinary Observatory for Research and Response) is an eight-year project funded by the ANR. The MARMOR project has two objectives: to structure the French scientific community by providing the Epos-France research infrastructure (formerly Résif) with the equipment required to conduct high-level research using submarine seismology and geodesy tools, to establish an underwater observation infrastructure in Mayotte in order to ensure continuous, real-time, 24/7 seismological monitoring and to support multidisciplinary research on the phenomena associated with the ongoing seismo-volcanic crisis."@en

description ap "Le site de Molène était un observatoire côtier câblé déployé au large de l’île de Molène en mer d’Iroise entre 2012 et 2017. Dédié au suivi à long terme et à haute résolution de la biodiversité et de la biomasse côtières, il servait également de site de test pour la qualification in situ de capteurs et d’équipements marins. Le câble de l’observatoire a été définitivement endommagé en 2017 et le site a ensuite été démantelé."@fr
description ap "O sítio Molène era um observatório costeiro cablado implantado ao largo da ilha de Molène, no mar de Iroise, entre 2012 e 2017. Dedicado à monitorização de longo prazo e alta resolução da biodiversidade e biomassa costeiras, serviu também como local de teste para qualificação in situ de sensores e equipamentos marinhos. O cabo do observatório foi permanentemente danificado em 2017 e o sítio foi posteriormente desmantelado."@pt
description ap "The Molène site was a coastal cabled observatory deployed offshore Molène Island in the Iroise Sea between 2012 and 2017. Dedicated to long-term and high-resolution monitoring of coastal biodiversity and biomass, it also served as a testing site for in situ qualification of sensors and marine equipment. The observatory cable was permanently damaged in 2017 and the site was subsequently dismantled."@en

Nordic Seasni Volver a índice o Índice de individuos

IRI: https://w3id.org/earthsemantics/OSO#Nordic_Seas

La infraestructura regional Nordic Seas comprende 5 secciones de planeadores oceánicos, 4 estaciones de fondeo y un observatorio multi-array. Combina componentes de monitorización existentes, ampliados, con nuevas instalaciones, con el objetivo principal de mejorar la comprensión del papel de los Nordic Seas en el sistema climático global. En particular, la investigación multidisciplinar se centra en: Transporte de agua, circulación y propiedades de las masas de agua de los Nordic Seas Biogeoquímica subsuperficial • Emisiones de metano desde el fondo marino Variabilidad de los frentes entre aguas polares y atlánticas Caracterización geofísica, oceanográfica y ecológica de una fuente hidrotermal La actividad se muestra en el mapa, donde los transectos de planeadores se indican con líneas rojas y números, los fondeos con círculos blancos (Svinøy, Station M, South Cape, Fram Strait) y el observatorio multi-array con un círculo blanco (EMSO-Mohn). Disciplinas científicas EMSO: oceanografía física, biogeoquímica, ecología marina (planificada)
Regional EMSO facility in the Nordic Seas dedicated to multidisciplinary ocean observation and climate-related marine monitoring.

definition ap "Ontology FAIRness Evaluator (O'FAIRe) er en metadatabasert metodikk og webapplikasjon for automatisk vurdering av FAIRness for ontologier og semantiske artefakter. definition ap "Ontology FAIRness Evaluator (O'FAIRe) es una metodología y una aplicación web de evaluación automática de la FAIRness, basadas en metadatos, para ontologías y artefactos semánticos. definition ap "Ontology FAIRness Evaluator (O'FAIRe) est une méthodologie et une application web d’évaluation automatique de la FAIRness, fondées sur les métadonnées, pour les ontologies et les artefacts sémantiques. Elle évalue les artefacts sémantiques à l’aide de 61 questions d’évaluation issues de la méthodologie O'FAIRe et produit des scores FAIR conformes aux principes FAIR."@fr
definition ap "Ontology FAIRness Evaluator (O'FAIRe) este o metodologie și o aplicație web de evaluare automată a FAIRness, bazate pe metadate, pentru ontologii și artefacte semantice. definition ap "Το Ontology FAIRness Evaluator (O'FAIRe) είναι μια μεθοδολογία και διαδικτυακή εφαρμογή αυτόματης αξιολόγησης της FAIRness, βασισμένη σε μεταδεδομένα, για οντολογίες και σημασιολογικά τεχνουργήματα.
